<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
cur=current_frame
A=cur.ascii.split('\n')
nodes=cur.segmentation['nodes']
def bbox(n):
    rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']];cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
    return min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
def fs(A,r0,c0,w=5,h=5):
    return frozenset((i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if A[r0+i][c0+j]=='B')
def norm(s):
    mr=min(i for i,j in s);mc=min(j for i,j in s);return frozenset((i-mr,j-mc) for i,j in s)
def dih(s):
    out=set();s=norm(s)
    for _ in range(4):
        out.add(s);out.add(norm(frozenset((i,4-j) for i,j in s)));s=norm(frozenset((j,i) for i,j in s))
    return out
def dist(a,b): return min(len(x^y) for x in dih(a) for y in dih(b))
Pcard={}
for b in nodes:
    if b['color']!='B':continue
    r0,r1,c0,c1=bbox(b)
    if r1>35:continue
    g=fs(A,r0,c0)
    for c in nodes:
        if c['color']=='P':
            cr0,cr1,cc0,cc1=bbox(c)
            if cr0<r0 and cr1>r1 and cc0<c0 and cc1>c1: Pcard[(cr0,cc0)]=g
order=[(4,22),(4,45),(13,22),(13,45),(22,22),(22,45)]
idx={k:i for i,k in enumerate(order)}
slot_cols=[15,22,29,36,43]
target=[3,4,0,1,2]
def bracket_slot():
    for b in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if b['color']=='W':
            r0,r1,c0,c1=bbox(b)
            if r1<50: return min(range(5),key=lambda i:abs(slot_cols[i]-c0))
    return None
def slot_idx(i):
    A2=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    for b in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if b['color']!='B':continue
        r0,r1,c0,c1=bbox(b)
        if 51<=r0 and r1<=57 and abs(c0-slot_cols[i])<=1:
            g=fs(A2,r0,c0)
            d=sorted((dist(g,v),idx[k]) for k,v in Pcard.items())
            return d[0]
    return (99,-1)
def stop(r): return any(r.get(k) for k in ('no_impact','level_completed','done','game_over','run_complete'))
trace=[]; r={}
for i in range(5):
    r={}
    br=bracket_slot(); guard=0
    while br!=i and guard<8:
        act='RIGHT' if i>br else 'LEFT'
        r=action([act]); guard+=1
        if stop(r): trace.append(("STOP-move",i,act)); break
        br=bracket_slot()
    if stop(r): break
    presses=0
    for _ in range(10):
        d,ix=slot_idx(i)
        if ix==target[i] and d==0: break
        r=action(['UP']); presses+=1
        if stop(r): trace.append(("STOP-up",i,presses)); break
    d,ix=slot_idx(i)
    trace.append((i,ix,d,target[i],presses))
    if stop(r): break
print("slots(idx,dist,target,up):",trace)
print("bracket",bracket_slot(),"level",current_frame.level,"step",current_frame.step)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
